entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Three goblin raiders
entries.text:
Three Goblin raiders burst from cover at the Raided Waystation and close in. They haven't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the goblin raiders.

log: Opening attack.
You use Greatsword: d20 [4] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 9 vs AC 13. Miss.
Your initiative: d20 [1] + 1 = 2.
Goblin Raider initiative: d20 5 + 2 = 7.
Turn order: Goblin Raider → You.
Round 1 begins.
Goblin Raider 1: d20 [12] (normal) +3 = 15 vs your AC 16. Miss.
Goblin Raider 2: d20 [20] (normal) +3 = 23 vs your AC 16. Critical hit!
2d4 [1, 3] + 1 + Ganging Up 1d4 [4] = 9 Slashing damage. 9 damage recorded: 0 absorbed by temporary HP, 9 HP lost.
Goblin Raider 3: d20 [15] (normal) +3 = 18 vs your AC 16. Hit.
1d4 [2] + 1 + Ganging Up 1d4 [1] = 4 Slashing damage. 4 damage recorded: 0 absorbed by temporary HP, 3 HP lost.
You fall unconscious and are dying. Your attackers leave you where you fell. Each turn, roll to hold on: three successes and you stabilise, three failures and you die.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Three goblin raiders
story.premise: A combat test: three goblin raiders ambush Kara Vell at the Raided Waystation while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: Three Goblin raiders burst from cover at the Raided Waystation and close in. They haven't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the goblin raiders.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A wiry green-grey goblin with oversized ears, a jagged grin and a helmet made from a dented cooking pot. It carries a chipped short blade and a rope belt hung with stolen trinkets.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Raided Waystation
bridge.description: A burned-out waystation with a smashed well cover and scattered supply crates.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Starving Dire Wolf
entries.text:
A Starving Dire Wolf bursts from cover at the Frozen Pine Hollow and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Starving Dire Wolf.

log: Opening attack.
You use Greatsword: d20 [18] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 23 vs AC 13. Hit.
10 slashing damage (5 + 2 +3).
Your initiative: d20 [4] + 2 = 6.
Starving Dire Wolf initiative: d20 12 + 2 = 14.
Turn order: Starving Dire Wolf → You.
Round 1 begins.
Starving Dire Wolf: d20 [12] (normal) +4 = 16 vs your AC 16. Hit.
1d6 [3] + 2 = 5 Piercing damage. 5 damage recorded: 0 absorbed by temporary HP, 5 HP lost.
Knockdown: Strength save d20 [10] + 3 = 13 vs DC 13. Success. You keep your feet.
Your turn.
A Starving Dire Wolf bursts from cover at the Frozen Pine Hollow and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Starving Dire Wolf
story.premise: A combat test: a Starving Dire Wolf ambushes Vey Nightmere at the Frozen Pine Hollow while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Starving Dire Wolf bursts from cover at the Frozen Pine Hollow and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the Starving Dire Wolf.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A huge grey-black wolf, ribs showing through matted fur, yellow eyes and a torn left ear. Its muzzle is scarred and its hackles stand high.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Frozen Pine Hollow
bridge.description: A snow-dusted hollow ringed by dark pines, with fresh tracks circling a fallen log.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

storyLog.text: Random hostile encounter: Starving Dire Wolf: the tale began at Caravan Camp.

entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Bandit Cutthroat
entries.text:
A Bandit Cutthroat bursts from cover at the Overgrown Roadside and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Bandit Cutthroat.

log: Opening attack.
You use Dagger: d20 [1] (normal) + 2 Dexterity + 2 proficiency = 5 vs AC 12. Miss.
Your initiative: d20 [8] + 2 = 10.
Bandit Cutthroat initiative: d20 12 + 1 = 13.
Turn order: Bandit Cutthroat → You.
Round 1 begins.
Bandit Cutthroat: d20 [4] (normal) +3 = 7 vs your AC 12. Miss.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Bandit Cutthroat
story.premise: A combat test: a Bandit Cutthroat ambushes Aelith Morrow at the Overgrown Roadside while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Bandit Cutthroat bursts from cover at the Overgrown Roadside and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the Bandit Cutthroat.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A lean human bandit in a patched leather jerkin and a mud-stained hood, a notched scimitar in one hand and a knife in the other. A scarf covers the lower face; a crude tattoo of a crow marks one wrist.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Overgrown Roadside
bridge.description: A rutted forest road narrowed by brambles, where a toppled cart blocks the way.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

storyLog.text: Random hostile encounter: Bandit Cutthroat: the tale began at Caravan Camp.
